uncited: A set of vertices is considered close if their maximum pairwise L2 distance is below this value.
Vertices are nearly collinear if the absolute value of the Pearson correlation coefficient computed from them exceeds this value.
*   If $d_{max} < \omega_{dist}$, the vertices are considered close.
*   If the absolute value of the Pearson correlation coefficient exceeds $\omega_{pear}$, the vertices are considered nearly collinear.
*   If $d < \omega_{dist}$, the vertices are considered close.
